svg.title: Goldbach v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
GOLDBACH · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the arithmetic frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives the Goldbach statement in one step; and it
is exactly the statement.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
Every examination of an even number is a physical run of the search,
registered at the Landauer floor; a run ending with no split would leave an
unsplit record, and the carrier registers none. Its last field is the bit read in
the register of heat, carried as a field, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the statement.

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the statement, in any vocabulary,
is a delivery of both kinds.

RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The one refuter
One even number at least four with no split refutes
both kinds at once, and the statement itself.

svg.text: THE WITNESSES OF THE SUBJECT, TYPED · EACH STRICTLY INSIDE THE BIT OR SHORT OF IT
The certified region to 4·10¹⁸
Carried as a field: load-bearing below its height,
never reaching above it.

svg.text: The ternary and Chen theorems
Their shared shape does not give the binary: on an
abstract frame both hold and the binary fails.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The binary gives the ternary
In Mathlib's vocabulary the binary statement gives
the ternary; the shape the ternary shares never
gives the binary.
